function.description: Sell (close) an OPEN prediction position before the market resolves, for whatever it's currently worth. Use solana.predict.claim instead once the market has RESOLVED and this position is a winner — claim settles at the resolved price; a sell takes whatever the book offers and Vex applies the provider's own default tolerance — size the position accordingly. Broadcasts and returns truthful-pending; estimatedPayoutUsd in the output is an order-preview ESTIMATE, not executed truth. Payouts settle in JupUSD (6 decimals), not USDC, and they arrive in a LATER keeper transaction — this call's broadcast does not deliver them, so the position stays pending until settlement is observed. To convert a payout to USDC, run solana.swap.quote/solana.swap.execute with tokenIn JupUSD, tokenOut USDC once the balance appears.
function.name: solana__predict_sell
